# Mold Busters

> Professional mold remediation, air quality testing, and asbestos removal services across Ontario and Quebec with IICRC/NAMP certified experts.

Mold Busters provides comprehensive environmental services including mold inspection, remediation, air quality testing, moisture control, and asbestos testing throughout major cities in Ontario and Quebec. The company specializes in residential and commercial properties with 24/7 emergency response and eco-friendly solutions.

## Key Topics

- Mold remediation and removal
- Indoor air quality (IAQ) testing
- IICRC and NAMP certifications
- Asbestos testing and removal
- Moisture control and prevention
- Infrared thermal imaging inspections
- Ottawa and Montreal service areas
- Emergency mold services
- Water damage restoration
- Home and property inspections
- Health and safety compliance
- VOCs and air pollutants
- Humidity control solutions
- Ontario and Quebec coverage
- SmartSense monitoring systems

## Core Services

- [Professional Air Quality Testing Service](https://www.bustmold.com/our-services/testing-services/air-quality-testing): Air quality testing using infrared cameras, moisture meters & hygrometers
- [Moisture Control Services in Ottawa & Montreal](https://www.bustmold.com/our-services/remediation-services/moisture-control): Moisture control & SmartSense monitoring to prevent mold growth
- [Living Room Mold Removal Service](https://www.bustmold.com/our-services/remediation-services/mold-removal/living-room-mold-removal): Living room mold remediation in Ottawa & Montreal with eco-friendly methods
- [Annual Indoor Air Quality Monitoring](https://www.bustmold.com/our-services/testing-services/air-quality-testing/annual-monitoring): Annual IAQ monitoring for commercial & residential properties per WHO/EPA
- [Insulation Inspection Services in Ottawa and Montreal](https://www.bustmold.com/our-services/inspection-services/infrared-inspection/insulation-inspection): Non-destructive thermal imaging insulation inspection in Ottawa & Montreal
- [Professional Building Demolition Services](https://www.bustmold.com/our-services/remediation-services/demolition): Building demolition & asbestos removal in Ontario & Quebec
- [Test de détection de l'amiante professionnels et certifiés](https://fr.bustmold.com/nos-services/analyses/analyse-amiante): Professional asbestos testing in Montreal, Ottawa & Gatineau
- [Inspección gratuita de moho - Obtén una inspección y consulta virtual en línea](https://es.bustmold.com/servicios/inspeccion-virtual): Virtual mold inspection service by IICRC/NAMP certified experts
